subject: Get 10x value from Lovable by mastering prompting (I/II)
preview:
Hey there,
Ever wondered why experienced users mak...
body:
Hey there,
Ever wondered why experienced users make Lovable look so easy? How they prompt makes (almost) all the difference.

Here's how to get 10x better results from Lovable:
* Give Lovable context on the problem you are trying to solve
* Break your asks down into smaller parts
* Be specific about what you want to change, and what you want to change it to
* Include images in your prompts to guide Lovable more precisely
Ready to try these techniques in Lovable? ( https://lovable.dev/ )

To dive deeper,
check out this video we created with our friend Mark on how to prompt Lovable correctly:

( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IqWfKj4mUIo&utm_source=marketinglifecycle&utm_medium=email1nontech&utm_campaign=creativeabtest )

Cheers,
Anton
